erreurs.REQUETE_INVALIDE: Some information is invalid. Correct the highlighted fields and try again.
erreurs.NON_AUTHENTIFIE: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
erreurs.IDENTIFIANTS_INVALIDES: Incorrect identifier or password. Check what you typed and try again.
erreurs.SESSION_EXPIREE: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
erreurs.ACCES_REFUSE: You are not allowed to do this. Ask a manager.
erreurs.AUCUNE_ENTREPRISE: This account has no back-office access to any active business. Contact the owner of your venue.
erreurs.ENTREPRISE_SUSPENDUE: Access to this business is suspended. Contact Tonti support.
erreurs.RESSOURCE_INTROUVABLE: This item no longer exists or has been deleted.
erreurs.CONFLIT_MODIFICATION: This item was changed on another device. It has been reloaded: check it and try again.
erreurs.CODE_ETABLISSEMENT_DEJA_UTILISE: This code is already used by another venue. Choose another one.
erreurs.STOCK_INSUFFISANT: Not enough stock for this item. Remove it from the bill or choose another product.
erreurs.COMPTE_VERROUILLE: Too many failed attempts: the account is locked for a few minutes. Try again later.
erreurs.TROP_DE_TENTATIVES: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
erreurs.ERREUR_INTERNE: An unexpected error occurred. Try again; if it persists, give the code shown to support.
erreurs.RESEAU_INDISPONIBLE: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.
erreurs.CODE_APPAIRAGE_INVALIDE: Invalid or expired code. Ask the manager for a new code.
erreurs.PIN_INCORRECT: Wrong code. After the 5th wrong code, the profile is blocked.
erreurs.PROFIL_BLOQUE: Profile blocked after 5 wrong codes. A manager must reset the PIN.
erreurs.VALIDATION_REQUISE: This action needs a manager’s approval.
erreurs.VALIDATION_INVALIDE: Approval expired or already used. Ask the manager again.
erreurs.TAXE_EN_USAGE: Active products are subject to this tax: change their tax first.
erreurs.CATEGORIE_EN_USAGE: This category contains active products: move or disable them first.
erreurs.SALLE_EN_USAGE: This area still has active tables: move or disable them first.
erreurs.TABLE_OCCUPEE: This table already has an open tab: a colleague has probably just opened it. The floor plan is up to date.
erreurs.PRODUIT_EPUISE: This product is sold out for today. It was not added.
erreurs.PRODUIT_INDISPONIBLE: This product is no longer on this location’s menu. It was not added.
erreurs.NOTE_NON_VIDE: This tab has items: it cannot be closed this way.
erreurs.NOTE_ENTAMEE: A payment has already been taken on this tab: it can no longer be changed.
erreurs.CAISSE_FERMEE: The till on this tablet is not open. Open it with its float to take payments.
erreurs.PLAFOND_ARDOISE_DEPASSE: This bill would take the customer over their tab limit. Confirm going over, or have part of it paid now.
erreurs.ARDOISE_NON_SOLDEE: This customer still owes money: the tab stays open until it is settled.
erreurs.TABLE_INDISPONIBLE: This table was just removed from the floor plan (deactivated by a manager). The plan is up to date: choose another table.
erreurs.REMBOURSEMENT_TROP_ANCIEN: A bill paid more than 30 days ago can no longer be refunded.

erreursAvecDelai.COMPTE_VERROUILLE: Too many failed attempts: the account is locked. Try again in {{duree}}.
erreursAvecDelai.TROP_DE_TENTATIVES: Too many attempts. Try again in {{duree}}.

vide.phrase: This venue’s menu is empty. The owner builds it in the back office, Products.

prise.phrase: Tap your name, then type your code.

vide.titre: Nobody can take this till yet
vide.phrase: A manager adds the staff of {{etablissement}} in the back office, Staff: each gets a PIN to open the till.

prise.verrouillage_one: The till locks itself after {{count}} minute without activity and comes back here.
prise.verrouillage_other: The till locks itself after {{count}} minutes without activity and comes back here.
prise.choisir: Tap your name to open the till.

bloque.phrase: Five wrong codes were typed. To protect your account, this profile can no longer open the till.
bloque.marche: A manager opens the back office, Staff, then “Reset PIN” for {{prenom}}. You will get a new temporary code, then choose your own.

nouveauPin.phrase: The code from your manager was temporary. Choose one nobody else knows: it signs your orders and payments.
nouveauPin.regle: 4 to 6 digits. Avoid codes that are too simple (0000, 1234) and your birth date: they are refused.
nouveauPin.tropSimple: Code too easy to guess: avoid sequences (1234) and repeated digits (1111).
nouveauPin.different: The two codes do not match. Start again.

vide.phrase: Tap a product on the menu to add it.

note.epuise: {{produit}} has just been marked sold out ({{qui}}, {{heure}}). It was not added.
note.epuiseSansDetail: {{produit}} is sold out for today. It was not added.
note.indisponible: {{produit}} is no longer on the menu. It was not added.

ligne.phrase: Instruction for preparation, applies to every unit on this line.
ligne.aide: For example: no chili, well done.

note.refusEnvoi: Nothing was sent. {{produit}} was marked sold out ({{qui}}, {{heure}}): remove it from the tab, then send again.
note.refusEnvoiSansDetail: Nothing was sent. {{produit}} is sold out: remove it from the tab, then send again.
note.refusEnvoiRetire: Nothing was sent. {{produit}} is no longer on the menu: remove it from the tab, then send again.

annulation.phrase: {{ou}}, sent to preparation at {{heure}}. The cancellation is recorded with its reason, visible to the manager and the owner.
annulation.validationContexte: {{ou}}. Item already sent to preparation, requested by {{demandeur}} for the reason: {{motif}}.

transfert.phrase: {{numero}}, {{montant}}. Every item follows the tab, sent or not: nothing is remade in the kitchen.
transfert.aucune: No free table in this area.

serveur.phrase: The tab goes to the chosen colleague: it becomes their table. Recorded in the activity.
serveur.aucun: No other employee takes orders here.

couverts.phrase: The number of guests is used in reports.

annulationNote.phrase: The table becomes free. {{numero}}, opened at {{heure}} by {{serveur}}
annulationNote.validationContexte: {{numero}}. Items already sent to preparation ({{montant}}), cancellation requested by {{demandeur}} for the reason: {{motif}}.

note.parCaissier: A cashier takes payment for this tab.
note.entamee: {{paye}} already paid: the tab can no longer be changed.

plan.mesTablesVide: None of your tabs is open in this area.
plan.lectureSeule: View only: your role does not take orders.

vide.phrase: A manager creates areas and tables in management, Areas and tables. Counter and takeaway sales remain available.

ouverture.phraseTable_one: {{salle}}, {{count}} seat. The number of guests is used in reports.
ouverture.phraseTable_other: {{salle}}, {{count}} seats. The number of guests is used in reports.
ouverture.phraseEmporter: The name is used to call the customer when the order is ready.

remise.phrase: {{ou}}. The discount lowers the price paid; the kitchen is not affected.
remise.plafond: Your limit: {{taux}}. Above it, a manager approves with their PIN. Every discount appears in the activity, with its reason.
remise.sansPlafond: A manager approves this discount with their PIN. Every discount appears in the activity, with its reason.
remise.choisir: Choose a rate or an amount.

offert.phrase: {{ou}}. The free item stays on the tab at 0; the kitchen prepares it as usual.

remettre.phrase: {{ou}}. Check the items before handing over.

stock.phrase: The recorded stock is used up. A delivery may not have been recorded: the sale will be flagged to the manager.

vide.phrase: Today's sales, stock to watch and till sessions will show here from the first checkouts.

vendu.comparaison: versus last {{jour}} at the same time ({{montant}})
vendu.rienAvant: Nothing sold last {{jour}} by this time

rupture.detail: {{etablissement}}: no longer sold at the till

ardoises.detail: {{clients}} customers owe for more than 30 days

reglages.phrase: What the till prints: name and tax ID come from the company.
reglages.auto: Print the receipt as soon as a bill is paid
reglages.autoAide: Otherwise, the till offers to print or to go on without a receipt.

enLigne.introuvablePhrase: This link does not lead to any receipt. Check that the link is complete, or ask the venue for it again.
enLigne.qr: QR code of the online receipt

whatsapp.aide: The customer receives a link to the receipt. The number is not stored.
whatsapp.ouvert: WhatsApp is open: just send the message.

introuvable.phrase: The address {{chemin}} does not match any screen. Check the link or go back to the home screen.

miseAJour.message: A new version of Tonti is available.

validation.codeFormat: 2 to 10 capital letters or digits, no spaces.
validation.motDePasseCourt: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
validation.contact: Enter a phone number or an email address.
validation.note: This approval covers this action only, for 60 seconds. It is recorded with the manager’s name.
validation.choisir: Tap the name of the approving manager.
validation.aucun: Nobody at this venue can approve this action with a PIN. A manager must first choose their code on a till.

connexion.phrase: With the phone number or email of your Tonti account.
connexion.identifiantAide: Phone: local number ({{pays}}), spaces optional. Other countries: start with “+” and the country code.
connexion.oubli: Forgot your password? Contact the owner of your venue.

validation.identifiant: Enter your phone number or email.

choixEntreprise.phrase: Your account gives access to several businesses. You can switch from the top bar.

vide.phrase: Add your first point of sale to open a till there.
vide.phraseSansDroit: Only a manager allowed to manage venues can add one.

formulaire.codeAide: 2 to 10 capital letters or digits, for example BE.
formulaire.verrouillageAide: After this long without activity, the till goes back to “Who is taking the till?”.
formulaire.politiqueStockAide: What the till does when a drink has no recorded stock left.

vide.phrase: Create the first client business: its owner will then be able to sign in.

entreprises.creeeCompteExistant: {{nom}} has been created and linked to the owner's existing account, who keeps their password.

suspension.consequence: Nobody will be able to sign in to this business and current sessions will be cut. You can reactivate it at any time.

reactivation.consequence: Its users will be able to sign in again.

formulaireEntreprise.telephoneAide: Local number ({{pays}}), spaces optional. Other countries: start with “+” and the country code.
formulaireEntreprise.contactAide: At least a phone number or an email: it is used to sign in.
formulaireEntreprise.codeAide: 2 to 10 capital letters or digits, for example BE.
formulaireEntreprise.tvaAide: Rate that applies in the country. The owner can change it in the taxes.

inscription.phrase: Your business, your first venue and your owner account, all at once.

personnel.phrase: Each employee has one role per venue. The till opens with a PIN; the back office, with an account.

vide.phrase: Add your servers, cashiers and managers: each will get a PIN to open the till.

personnel.cree: {{nom}} has been added to the staff.

desactivation.consequence: {{nom}} will no longer be able to sign in, neither at the till nor in the back office, and open sessions will be closed. Their sales stay under their name.

pinConfirmation.consequence: The old PIN will stop working. A new temporary PIN will be shown once; it must be changed at the next till sign-in.

codes.consequence: Hand them over in person or in writing. They will not be shown again: they will be replaced at first sign-in.
codes.perdu: Lost code? “Reset PIN” generates a new one.
codes.compteExistant: This phone number or email already had a Tonti account: {{nom}} will sign in to the back office with their usual password and see {{entreprise}} among their businesses. Check with the person that it really is their number or email; otherwise, remove their access.

formulaire.rolesAide: One role per venue. Leave “None” where the employee does not work.
formulaire.adminAide: All rights, in every venue, including those opened later.
formulaire.accesAide: The chosen role allows it. Servers, cashiers and kitchen staff only use the till.
formulaire.accesImpossible: None of the chosen roles opens the back office: the employee will use the till with their PIN.
formulaire.accesSansRole: Choose a role first: the back office opens with the {{roles}} role.
formulaire.accesExistant: Signs in to the back office with {{identifiant}}.
formulaire.codesInfo: On saving, a temporary PIN is generated, and a temporary password if back-office access is given. They are shown only once.
formulaire.conflit: This employee was changed in the meantime: the form now shows the up-to-date information. Redo your changes.
formulaire.parEtablissement: Role per venue: manager, cashier, server or kitchen

motDePasse.phrase: This is your first sign-in: replace the temporary password with a personal one.
motDePasse.sessions: Your other open sessions will be closed.
motDePasse.different: The two passwords do not match.
motDePasse.change: Password saved. Sign in again with your new password.

tablette.phrase: A manager opens Tonti on their phone, in the back office: Tablets, then Register a tablet. They choose the venue and the name of this till, and get a 6-digit code. Type that code here.
tablette.etape1: The manager generates the code on their phone.
tablette.etape2: You type it on this tablet, within 10 minutes.
tablette.etape3: The tablet becomes a till of the venue: staff sign in with their PIN.
tablette.motDePasse: The manager’s password is never typed on this tablet.
tablette.aide: The code is submitted at the 6th digit. Expired or wrong code: ask the manager for a new one.

tablettes.phrase: Devices allowed to act as a till. A lost or stolen tablet is revoked here: it is cut off immediately.

vide.phrase: Register the tablet of each till: staff will sign in there with their PIN.

formulaire.nomAide: As staff will see it, for example “Till 1, bar”.

code.pour: For “{{nom}}”. On the tablet, open Tonti and type this code.
code.aTaper: Code to type on the tablet
code.attente: Waiting for the tablet: this screen updates once it is registered.
code.expire: This code expired without being used.

revocation.consequence: The tablet is cut off immediately: nobody can sign in on it any more. To reuse it, register it again with a code.

renommage.consequence: The new name shows on the tablet and in this list.

taxes.phrase: The rates applied to your products. Menu prices include tax: the tax is taken out on the receipt.

vide.phrase: Add the VAT that applies in your country: each product can then be subject to it.

formulaire.consequence: The rate applies to the tax-inclusive prices of the products subject to this tax.
formulaire.tauxInvalide: Enter a rate between 0 and 100, with at most two decimals.
formulaire.changementPhrase: The new rate applies to sales recorded from now on. Past sales keep their rate. The change will be visible in the activity, under your name.

taxes.enUsage_one: “{{nom}}” still applies to {{count}} active product: change its tax in its record first, then disable it.
taxes.enUsage_other: “{{nom}}” still applies to {{count}} active products: change their tax in their records first, then disable it.

produits.phrase: The menu shared by your venues. Prices include tax: the tax is worked out backwards and shown on the receipt.

vide.phrase: First create your categories (Grills, Beers…), then add your products with their price.
vide.phraseSansDroit: The owner or an administrator builds the menu.

produits.desactive: “{{nom}}” is disabled: it no longer shows on the till.
produits.note: A product that was sold is never deleted: disable it. Venue-specific prices and “sold out today” will come in each venue’s menu.

fiche.typeAide: Item: a product resold as is (tissues, cigarettes…).
fiche.prixAide: The price the customer pays, tax included.
fiche.suiviStockAide: Ticked by default for drinks and items. Deliveries and losses will be entered in the Stock module.
fiche.traceNote: A price or tax change is recorded in the activity (who, when, before and after) and does not affect sales already made.
fiche.prixSansDroit: Only an owner or an administrator changes prices.
fiche.coutRevientAide: Optional. What a dish costs (ingredients, gas): used for the margin. A new cost applies to later sales.
fiche.margePlat: Margin per dish: {{marge}}, i.e. {{taux}}% of the price before tax
fiche.coutInvalide: Enter an amount, or leave empty.

historique.phrase: Base price and venue prices. Sales keep the price they were made at.

categories.phrase: Their order is the order of the tabs on the till. The colour marks the products on the tiles.
categories.regle: A category that contains active products cannot be disabled: move or disable its products first.
categories.enUsage_one: “{{nom}}” still contains {{count}} active product: move it to another category or disable it first.
categories.enUsage_other: “{{nom}}” still contains {{count}} active products: move them to another category or disable them first.

carteEtablissement.phrase: What this venue’s till offers, and at what price. “Sold out today” clears itself the next morning at 4 am.

vide.phrase: Products from the shared menu will show here once they are created.

fait.epuise: “{{nom}}” is sold out until 4 am tomorrow.

dialoguePrix.consequence: Menu base price: {{prix}}. This price only applies to the {{etablissement}} tills.
dialoguePrix.note: If the base price changes later, {{etablissement}} keeps this price. “Back to base price” removes it. The change is recorded in the activity, under your name.

activite.phrase: The actions that matter: prices, taxes, menu, staff, tablets, approvals. Who, when, and what changed.

vide.phrase: No action matches these filters. Widen the period or show everything.

types.SERVEUR_CHANGE: {{auteur}} handed the tab {{objet}} to another server at {{etablissement}}
types.RETRAIT_CAISSE: {{auteur}} withdrew cash from the till at {{etablissement}}
types.DEPENSE_CAISSE: {{auteur}} paid an expense in cash at {{etablissement}}
types.APPORT_CAISSE: {{auteur}} added cash to the till at {{etablissement}}
types.ECART_CAISSE: {{auteur}} closed the till with a difference at {{etablissement}} ({{objet}})
types.ECART_OUVERTURE_CAISSE: {{auteur}} opened the till with a discrepancy at {{etablissement}}
types.ECART_INVENTAIRE: {{auteur}} corrected the stock of {{objet}} by stocktake at {{etablissement}}
types.VENTE_ARDOISE: {{auteur}} put a bill on {{objet}}’s tab at {{etablissement}}
types.REGLEMENT_ARDOISE: {{auteur}} took a payment on {{objet}}’s tab at {{etablissement}}

actions.CLIENT_CREDIT: putting a bill on a tab

activite.depassementArdoiseValide: +{{montant}}, {{note}}. Owes {{solde}}, {{plafond}} limit exceeded by {{depassement}}. Approved by {{validateur}}

salles.phrase: Areas are the till tabs, in this order. A table that has been served is never deleted: disable it.

vide.phrase: Create your areas (Terrace, Room, Bar…), then add their tables: they will show on the till.

salles.enUsage_one: “{{nom}}” still has {{count}} active table: move or disable it first.
salles.enUsage_other: “{{nom}}” still has {{count}} active tables: move or disable them first.

dialogueSalle.consequence: The tab name on the till.

lot.consequence: All identical to start with; each can be adjusted afterwards (name, seats).

table.consequence: Its name is unique in the venue.

encaissement.verifier: Check on the phone that the payment has arrived before confirming.
encaissement.aide: Split payment possible: the rest can be paid with another method.

fin.recu: Receipts (print, WhatsApp) come with the receipts module.

ouverture.titre: The till on this tablet is not open
ouverture.phrase: Count the cash in the drawer before the first payment: it becomes the float and is checked at closing.
ouverture.sansDroit: A cashier or a manager opens the till with their code.
ouverture.premiere: First opening on this tablet: the counted float becomes the reference.
ouverture.aveugle: Count the whole drawer. The float left at the last closing appears once the count is confirmed, to check nothing moved.

partage.arrondi: Any rounding remainder goes on the last share.

aidesPaiement.parts: Each share is a payment: the bill closes with the last one.
aidesPaiement.articles: The amount comes from the chosen items, discounts included.

ardoise.aucun: No customer has a tab here. A manager can open one.
ardoise.aucunCreer: No customer has a tab here: open one with “New customer”.
ardoise.choisir: Choose the customer who will pay later.
ardoise.depassePhrase: Going over is recorded and visible to the owner. Otherwise, have part of it paid now.
ardoise.validerDepassement: Go over the limit: {{montant}} on {{nom}}’s tab
ardoise.validationContexte: Putting a bill on a tab needs a manager’s approval.

especes.reserve: The expected cash is shown to managers only: at closing, the drawer is counted before seeing what is expected.

tiroir.notesOuvertes_one: {{count}} bill still open at this location
tiroir.notesOuvertes_other: {{count}} bills still open at this location

dialogue.phrase: Cash goes in or out of the drawer without a sale. It counts in the expected cash at closing.

ouvertes.phrase: They stay open: paid on a later till session, they will count on its day.

cloture.etapes: 1. Count the cash, 2. See the difference, 3. Close
cloture.aveugle: Count the whole drawer, float included. The expected cash appears once the count is confirmed: count what you have, not what you should have.
cloture.fondLaisse: Float left for the next opening

z.fige: Frozen: it will not change. History comes with reports, printing with receipts.

vide.message: Bills show up here once paid.

remboursement.choisir: Pick a bill to see its details or refund it.
remboursement.toutRembourse: Every item on this bill has been refunded.
remboursement.aideEspeces: Out of the till, {{montant}} at most
remboursement.aidePaye: Sent back to the customer, {{montant}} at most
remboursement.trace: Logged as a critical action; in cash, it comes out of the till’s expected amount.
remboursement.aideArdoise: Reduces what the customer owes, up to {{montant}}
remboursement.ordre: Split across the bill’s payment methods: tab first, then card and Mobile Money, cash last.

autreJour.aide: Enter the receipt number, or scan its QR code. Up to 30 days, with a manager’s approval.
autreJour.introuvable: No receipt has this number in this venue.
autreJour.avertissement: Bill from another day: the money leaves today’s till and counts in its Z. A manager or the owner approves with their code.

remboursement.tropAncien: Paid more than 30 days ago: it can no longer be refunded.

stock.phrase: Drinks and items resold as is, per site. Cooked dishes are not tracked.

politiques.AVERTISSEMENT: warning, the till warns before selling
politiques.STRICT: strict, the till refuses to sell without stock

vide.phrase: Drinks and items on the menu show up here. A cooked dish is not tracked.

perte.phrase: Items that left the stock without being sold. Logged as a critical action.

seuil.phrase: Below this threshold, the product shows as “Low stock”: time to order.
seuil.invalide: A whole number, 0 for no alert.

historique.phrase: {{quantite}} in stock. Each movement keeps the resulting stock.

reception.phrase: {{etablissement}}. Quantities are added to stock once saved.
reception.aucune: Add the products of the delivery.
reception.aide: The purchase cost will be used for margins in reports.

inventaire.etape1: Step 1 of 2: count without looking at the recorded stock. A product left blank keeps its stock.
inventaire.etape2: Step 2 of 2: the differences. Each one corrects the stock and is logged as a critical action.
inventaire.pourValider: To confirm: the reason for the difference on {{liste}}.
inventaire.trace: Differences correct the stock and are logged as critical actions.

politiquesEffets.SOUPLE: The till sells even without stock at {{etablissement}}: negative stock points to an unrecorded delivery.
politiquesEffets.AVERTISSEMENT: At {{etablissement}}, the till warns when an item has no stock left, then sells once confirmed.
politiquesEffets.STRICT: At {{etablissement}}, the till refuses to sell an item with no stock left.

ardoise.phrase: Customers allowed to pay later. A bill goes on the tab at checkout.
ardoise.fermerPhrase: The customer will no longer be able to put anything on the tab. Their history stays available, and the tab can be reopened.

vide.phrase: Open a tab for trusted customers: they can pay later, up to their limit.

aucun.phrase: No customer matches this filter or search.

client.phrase: The customer will be able to put bills on the tab and pay later, at the till.
client.telephoneAide: Local number ({{pays}}), spaces optional. Other country: start with “+” and its code.
client.plafondAide: The most they can owe. Empty: no limit.
client.plafondInvalide: Enter an amount, or leave empty.

fiche.definitif: Every entry is final. A mistake is fixed by refunding the bill, never by editing what the customer owes.

caisse.aucun: No customer owes anything for now.
caisse.choisir: Choose the customer paying their tab.
caisse.auPlus: At most {{montant}}: what the customer owes.

manques.recu: the cash received covers the amount

caisse.solde: Payment of {{montant}} taken. {{nom}}’s tab is settled.

entreprise.phrase: What receipts print about the company. The name is changed by the Tonti team.
entreprise.numeroFiscalAide: Tax number for your country: it is on every receipt.

ventes.phrase: Paid bills, by till day: a bill paid after midnight counts for the day before.
ventes.remisesSurNotes: Amounts after item discounts. Whole-bill discounts: −{{montant}}, not split.

vide.phrase: Pick another period, or another venue.

indicateurs.coutConnu: on {{part}}% of revenue with a known cost

vigilance.rien: Nothing to report for this period.

caisses.phrase: Each till opening and its Z report, frozen at closing.

vide.phrase: Tills opened on the tablet show up here, with their Z report.

caisses.lecture: A difference is read on cash: counted minus expected. The explanation entered at closing is in the details.

detail.cloturee: {{etablissement}}. Opened {{jour}} at {{ouverture}} by {{nom}}, closed at {{cloture}} by {{par}}
